note: The unit files to load (units), and the path (sections): each section lists its units in order, and a unit's number is its place in the path; a bonus section's units have no number. Units with "lessons": "auto" split their theme's words into lessons of six, most frequent first, followed by a review lesson. Words of the themes in alwaysAllowed may appear in any sentence. See docs/PLAN.md.

goal.en: Introduce yourself and the people around you, and get by in everyday situations: the café, numbers, getting around, time, shopping, food, the home, clothes and people, the weather, the body and health, free time, school and work, services, and what happened yesterday.
goal.nb: Presenter deg selv og folkene rundt deg, og klar deg i hverdagen: kafeen, tall, å finne fram, tid, handling, mat, hjemmet, klær og folk, været, kroppen og helse, fritid, skole og jobb, tjenester, og hva som skjedde i går.

goal.en: Tell what happened and what you plan, give your opinion, and handle housing, work, travel and the news in simple terms.
goal.nb: Fortell hva som skjedde og hva du planlegger, si hva du mener, og klar deg med bolig, jobb, reiser og nyheter på en enkel måte.

goal.en: How Icelandic builds words for new things from its own old parts.
goal.nb: Hvordan islandsk lager ord for nye ting av sine egne gamle deler.
